# Environment variables

## Set when you run `docker compose` / `make`

Example: `RELIABILITY_MODE=default docker compose up -d --force-recreate worker-spot worker-core`.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `RELIABILITY_MODE` | `hardened` | hardened = acks_late + reject_on_worker_lost + prefetch 1; default = Celery's stock settings |
| `QUEUE_TYPE` | `classic` | classic or quorum queues (needs a fresh broker: `make reset`) |
| `CELERY_ACKS_LATE` | `(empty)` | override task_acks_late alone (true/false); empty = follow RELIABILITY_MODE |
| `CELERY_REJECT_ON_WORKER_LOST` | `(empty)` | override task_reject_on_worker_lost alone; empty = follow RELIABILITY_MODE |
| `CELERY_PREFETCH_MULTIPLIER` | `(empty)` | override worker_prefetch_multiplier alone; empty = follow RELIABILITY_MODE |
| `STALL_THRESHOLD_SECONDS` | `120` | the Task Police re-dispatch a call with no progress for this long |
| `POLICE_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `60` | how often beat runs the Task Police sweep |
| `CHUNK_MIN_SECONDS` | `5` | shortest simulated chunk-analysis time |
| `CHUNK_MAX_SECONDS` | `10` | longest simulated chunk-analysis time |
| `RABBITMQ_VERSION` | `4.3` | broker version to run, e.g. 4.2 |
| `REDIS_PORT` | `6380` | 6380, not 6379: a native redis-server often owns 6379 and silently shadows the container |
| `POSTGRES_PORT` | `5432` | host port for DB clients |
| `API_PORT` | `8100` | 8100, not 8000: 8000 is a very common port on dev machines |
| `VIZ_PORT` | `8200` | host port of the visualizer |

## Read by the Python code (`config.py`)

Everything else the code reads. Compose does not set these, so the defaults apply unless you add them to a service's `environment`.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `BROKER_URL` | `amqp://pipeline:pipeline@localhost:5672//` | AMQP URL of the broker |
| `DATABASE_URL` | `postgresql+psycopg://pipeline:pipeline@localhost:5432/pipeline` | SQLAlchemy URL of the durable workflow state |
| `HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_SECONDS` | `1` | how often a running chunk renews its lease |
| `LEASE_RETRY_SECONDS` | `3` | how long a duplicate delivery waits before re-checking a busy chunk |
| `LEASE_SECONDS` | `10` | a PROCESSING chunk with a heartbeat older than this is considered orphaned |
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | Python logging level for the JSON logs |
| `MAX_ATTEMPTS` | `4` | per-chunk executions (incl. crashes/redeliveries) before it goes to the DLQ |
| `MAX_RECOVERIES` | `3` | police re-dispatches per call before it is marked FAILED |
| `RABBITMQ_API_URL` | `http://localhost:15672/api` | RabbitMQ management API (used to peek at the dead-letter queue) |
| `RABBITMQ_PASSWORD` | `pipeline` | management API password (a documented dev default) |
| `RABBITMQ_USER` | `pipeline` | management API user |
| `RESULT_BACKEND` | `redis://localhost:6379/0` | where Celery stores results and chord bookkeeping |
| `RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE` | `2` | transient-error retries wait base**attempt seconds (2, 4, 8, ...) |
| `RETRY_BACKOFF_MAX` | `60` | ...capped at this many seconds |
| `SLOW_CHUNK_SECONDS` | `22` | duration of a chunk carrying the "slow" fault |
